key: A modern crypto wallet built for clear, private control.
en: A modern crypto wallet built for clear, private control.
val: Moderná kryptopeňaženka vytvorená pre jasnú a súkromnú kontrolu.

key: A network fee is what you pay the blockchain — not Aperture — to process your transaction. It goes to the people running the network, never to us.
en: A network fee is what you pay the blockchain — not Aperture — to process your transaction. It goes to the people running the network, never to us.

key: A private key controls a single account on a single network.
en: A private key controls a single account on a single network.
val: Súkromný kľúč ovláda jeden účet v jednej sieti.

key: A private key gives full control of this one account. Anyone who has it can move the funds.
en: A private key gives full control of this one account. Anyone who has it can move the funds.
val: Súkromný kľúč dáva úplnú kontrolu nad týmto jediným účtom. Ktokoľvek ho má, môže presunúť prostriedky.

key: A private key is the secret number that controls one account on one chain. It usually looks like a long string of letters and digits.
en: A private key is the secret number that controls one account on one chain. It usually looks like a long string of letters and digits.
val: Súkromný kľúč je tajné číslo, ktoré ovláda jeden účet na jednej sieti. Zvyčajne vyzerá ako dlhý reťazec písmen a číslic.

en: A receive address is a string that identifies one of your accounts on one specific chain. Sharing it lets someone send funds to that account.
val: Prijímacia adresa je reťazec, ktorý identifikuje jeden z vašich účtov na konkrétnom reťazci. Jej zdieľaním umožníte niekomu poslať prostriedky na tento účet.

key: A recipient can't be paid with what's left — lower an earlier amount or remove it
en: A recipient can't be paid with what's left — lower an earlier amount or remove it
val: A recipient can't be paid with what's left — lower an earlier amount or remove it

key: A recipient is an address on a blockchain — a long string that identifies one account. You can paste it, scan its QR code, or type a name that resolves to one (like an ENS name).
en: A recipient is an address on a blockchain — a long string that identifies one account. You can paste it, scan its QR code, or type a name that resolves to one (like an ENS name).
val: Príjemca je adresa na blockchaine – dlhý reťazec, ktorý identifikuje jeden účet. Môžete ho vložiť, naskenovať jeho QR kód alebo zadať názov, ktorý sa naň preloží (napríklad názov ENS).

key: A recovery phrase is twelve or twenty-four plain English words. Together they are the seed your wallet was generated from.
en: A recovery phrase is twelve or twenty-four plain English words. Together they are the seed your wallet was generated from.
val: Obnovovacia fráza je dvanásť alebo dvadsaťštyri bežných anglických slov. Spolu tvoria semienko, z ktorého bola vaša peňaženka vygenerovaná.

key: A timed log of the last pull-to-refresh — every chain's balance and history API, each RPC round-trip, and every database write, with how long each took. Pull to refresh on the wallet screen, then open this and tap Copy to share it.
en: A timed log of the last pull-to-refresh — every chain's balance and history API, each RPC round-trip, and every database write, with how long each took. Pull to refresh on the wallet screen, then open this and tap Copy to share it.
val: Časový záznam posledného potiahnutia na obnovenie — API zostatku a histórie každého reťazca, každý cyklus RPC a každý zápis do databázy s tým, ako dlho každý trval. Potiahnutím obnovte na obrazovke peňaženky, potom otvorte toto a klepnite na Kopírovať na zdieľanie.

key: A timed log of the last pull-to-refresh — every chain’s balance and history API, each RPC round-trip, and every database write, with how long each took. Pull to refresh on the wallet screen, then open this and tap Copy to share it.
en: A timed log of the last pull-to-refresh — every chain’s balance and history API, each RPC round-trip, and every database write, with how long each took. Pull to refresh on the wallet screen, then open this and tap Copy to share it.

key: A wallet built with the care a wallet should be built with.
en: A wallet built with the care a wallet should be built with.
val: Peňaženka vytvorená so starostlivosťou, akú si peňaženka zaslúži.

val: Peňaženku, ktorej obnovovaciu frázu ste si nikdy nezapísali, nemožno obnoviť. Na serveri nie je žiadna záloha — nie je žiadny server.

key: A watch-only wallet shows you what an address owns and what it has done — without ever holding the keys.
en: A watch-only wallet shows you what an address owns and what it has done — without ever holding the keys.
val: Peňaženka len na sledovanie ti ukazuje, čo adresa vlastní a čo robila — bez toho, aby kedy držala kľúče.
Aktívna adresa — má históriu v reťazi

en: Add ERC-20 / SPL tokens by pasting their contract or mint address. Aperture reads name, symbol, and decimals from chain.

en: Addresses are derived locally on this iPhone using Trust Wallet Core — the same open-source cryptography Trust Wallet itself uses, so importing this phrase here produces the same addresses you would see there.

val: Zistili sme kľúč EVM. Jeho účet je pripravený vo všetkých sieťach EVM a zabezpečený v tomto zariadení.

key: We’d love to know why you’re leaving and how we could be better. Every message reaches our team.
en: We’d love to know why you’re leaving and how we could be better. Every message reaches our team.
val: Radi by sme vedeli, prečo odchádzate a ako by sme mohli byť lepší. Každá správa sa dostane k nášmu tímu.

key: We'll broadcast a replacement that returns the funds to you. If the original confirms first, the send completes — and the cancel fee is still paid.
en: We'll broadcast a replacement that returns the funds to you. If the original confirms first, the send completes — and the cancel fee is still paid.
val: Vyšleme náhradu, ktorá vám vráti prostriedky. Ak sa pôvodná potvrdí skôr, odoslanie sa dokončí — a poplatok za zrušenie sa aj tak zaplatí.

key: When enabled, Aperture will fetch balances in the background by talking to public chain RPC providers. The providers may log the request — Aperture itself records nothing about you.
en: When enabled, Aperture will fetch balances in the background by talking to public chain RPC providers. The providers may log the request — Aperture itself records nothing about you.
val: Keď je zapnuté, Aperture na pozadí získava zostatky komunikáciou s verejnými RPC poskytovateľmi. Poskytovatelia si môžu požiadavku zaznamenať — samotná Aperture si o vás nič neukladá.

key: When enabled, the forgot-passcode sheet can erase Aperture from this iPhone. Use this only if every wallet is backed up, because local wallets, recovery phrases, passcodes, and app data are removed.
en: When enabled, the forgot-passcode sheet can erase Aperture from this iPhone. Use this only if every wallet is backed up, because local wallets, recovery phrases, passcodes, and app data are removed.
val: Keď je táto možnosť povolená, hárok zabudnutého prístupového kódu môže z tohto iPhone vymazať Aperture. Túto možnosť použite, iba ak je zálohovaná každá peňaženka, pretože sa odstránia miestne peňaženky, frázy na obnovenie, prístupové kódy a údaje aplikácií.

key: When written, the Terms will state plainly: Aperture provides software, not custody. You are responsible for your keys.
en: When written, the Terms will state plainly: Aperture provides software, not custody. You are responsible for your keys.
val: Keď sa podmienky napíšu, jasne uvedú: Aperture poskytuje softvér, nie úschovu. Za svoje kľúče zodpovedáte vy.

en: When you back a wallet up to iCloud, it shows up here to restore. You can create one from a wallet's recovery-phrase screen → Back up.

en: Wipes the on-disk price cache. The next refresh fetches fresh prices from Coinbase.

en: Your recovery phrase stays yours. You can import this wallet again with it — there is no server, and removing it here loses nothing you’ve written down.
val: Vaša obnovovacia fráza zostáva vaša. Túto peňaženku s ňou môžete znova importovať — nie je žiadny server a odstránenie tu nestratí nič, čo ste si zapísali.

key: Your recovery phrase was encrypted on your device with a password you chose. Only that encrypted copy lives in your private iCloud — Apple and Aperture can never read it.
en: Your recovery phrase was encrypted on your device with a password you chose. Only that encrypted copy lives in your private iCloud — Apple and Aperture can never read it.
val: Vaša obnovovacia fráza bola zašifrovaná vo vašom zariadení heslom, ktoré ste si zvolili. Vo vašom súkromnom iCloude je uložená iba táto zašifrovaná kópia — Apple ani Aperture ju nikdy nedokážu prečítať.

key: Your recovery phrase was verified and your keys are now secured on this device.
en: Your recovery phrase was verified and your keys are now secured on this device.
val: Vaša obnovovacia fráza bola overená a vaše kľúče sú teraz zabezpečené v tomto zariadení.

key: Your recovery phrase will be replaced.
en: Your recovery phrase will be replaced.

key: Your wallet history, contacts, cached balances, and portfolio snapshots.
en: Your wallet history, contacts, cached balances, and portfolio snapshots.
val: História vašej peňaženky, kontakty, zostatky vo vyrovnávacej pamäti a snímky portfólia.

key: Your wallet is on this iPhone only. If your iPhone is lost, broken, or wiped, your wallet — and everything in it — is gone. The recovery phrase is the only way back.
en: Your wallet is on this iPhone only. If your iPhone is lost, broken, or wiped, your wallet — and everything in it — is gone. The recovery phrase is the only way back.
val: Vaša peňaženka existuje len v tomto iPhone. Ak iPhone stratíte, rozbijete alebo vymažete, peňaženka — a všetko v nej — bude preč. Obnovovacia fráza je jedinou cestou späť.

key: Your wallet is ready. Back up your recovery phrase so you can restore it later if you lose this device.
en: Your wallet is ready. Back up your recovery phrase so you can restore it later if you lose this device.
val: Vaša peňaženka je pripravená. Zálohujte si frázu na obnovenie, aby ste ju mohli neskôr obnoviť, ak toto zariadenie stratíte.

key: Your wallet is ready. Balances and activity will appear as networks refresh.
en: Your wallet is ready. Balances and activity will appear as networks refresh.
val: Vaša peňaženka je pripravená. Zostatky a aktivita sa zobrazia pri obnovovaní sietí.

key: Your wallet was created successfully and is ready to use.
en: Your wallet was created successfully and is ready to use.
val: Vaša peňaženka bola úspešne vytvorená a je pripravená na použitie.

key: Your wallet was imported successfully and is ready to use.
en: Your wallet was imported successfully and is ready to use.
val: Vaša peňaženka bola úspešne importovaná a je pripravená na použitie.

key: Your written phrase is the only copy. Aperture has no copy of it — keep it safe.
en: Your written phrase is the only copy. Aperture has no copy of it — keep it safe.
val: Vaša zapísaná fráza je jedinou kópiou. Aperture nemá žiadnu jej kópiu — uchovajte ju v bezpečí.

key: Your passcode unlocks Aperture and protects this iPhone's copy of your wallets.
en: Your passcode unlocks Aperture and protects this iPhone's copy of your wallets.
val: Váš prístupový kód odomkne Aperture a ochráni kópiu vašich peňaženiek v tomto iPhone.

key: Your passcode unlocks Aperture. %@ is a faster shortcut to the same lock — you can always fall back to passcode.
en: Your passcode unlocks Aperture. %@ is a faster shortcut to the same lock — you can always fall back to passcode.
val: Váš prístupový kód odomkne Aperture. %@ je rýchlejšia skratka k rovnakému zámku – vždy sa môžete vrátiť k prístupovému kódu.

key: Without a passcode, your wallet is only protected by your iPhone's lock screen. Turn on a passcode to require authentication every time you open Aperture — and to use %@.
en: Without a passcode, your wallet is only protected by your iPhone's lock screen. Turn on a passcode to require authentication every time you open Aperture — and to use %@.
val: Bez prístupového kódu je vaša peňaženka chránená iba uzamknutou obrazovkou vášho iPhone. Zapnite prístupový kód, ktorý bude vyžadovať overenie pri každom Aperturení Aperture – a použiť %@.

key: Require %@ before each of these actions. If it fails, you can fall back to your passcode.
en: Require %@ before each of these actions. If it fails, you can fall back to your passcode.
val: Pred každou z týchto akcií vyžadovať %@. Ak zlyhá, môžete sa vrátiť k svojmu prístupovému kódu.
